name: Great UI
summary: Fifty copy-paste React components with Tailwind CSS and Motion: transitions, text effects, cards and buttons.
description: Collection of 50 production-ready, WAI-ARIA accessible React components built with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4 and Motion, covering social cards, visuals, typography, page and theme transitions, buttons and layout blocks. Copy the source or install from its shadcn registry; MIT licensed and free.
contains: sections: social cards, visuals, typography, page transitions, theme transitions, buttons, layout & cards
built with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4 and Motion
WAI-ARIA accessible, light and dark modes
